_comment: Real-life Taiwan-accent clips: YouTube videos under Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY 3.0) with human-made Traditional Chinese subtitles (not auto-generated). Only this list and the scripts are in git; audio and subtitles are downloaded into datasets/youtube_tw by fetch_youtube.py for local testing. Subtitles are often edited or condensed, so CER against them is pessimistic. No speaker labels: score CER and latency only.
